name: Composite Fabrics of America LLC
old_description: Carbon fiber and composite materials for aerospace applications
about:
Composite Fabrics of America LLC operates from Hiddenite, North Carolina, as a wholly owned subsidiary of Schneider Mills, one of the oldest and most advanced weaving mills in the United States. The company leverages that legacy to produce carbon fiber and composite reinforcing materials for demanding applications.

The firm specializes in industry-standard and custom reinforcing fabrics for aerospace composite part fabrication and repair. Its textile engineers collaborate with customers to develop custom reinforcing products that meet design-specific requirements, reduce waste, or add aesthetic appeal. A "Bill and Hold" service allows clients to lock in pricing and secure fabric availability against market fluctuations.

The company serves aerospace, automotive, infrastructure, and athletics markets. Aerospace customers include those fabricating and repairing composite parts for aircraft, space, and defense programs, supported by a quality system certified to AS9100 Rev D.

Certification to AS9100 Rev D underscores its quality system for the Aircraft, Space and Defense industry. The Schneider Mills heritage combined with the CFA team’s capabilities is cited as the foundation for its quality and innovation in composite fabric development.
